pending_bindings: ROOT must provide the actual canonical rebuilt manifest path/SHA/bytes. No manifest hash or byte count is inferred.
ROOT must review and pin the new policy, then replace the worker policy and manifest null pins. The assignment ref is bound to the authored complete six-case source from the first proposal.
ROOT must confirm the existing replay module bytes at the proposed V6 snapshot path. Its transitive snapshot, not the unchanged module hash alone, must match the new source identity.
The V6 cache-equivalence reference is deliberately null and its status NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_V6. Any later equivalence claim requires evidence for V6 rather than the old 874-to-194 result.

Keep ROOT_ACTIVATED false until ROOT has approved the complete exact bindings and preparation scope. Installing a policy, invoking the API, copying files into the container and starting any clock are separate future actions.

preparation_controls.stdout: Only audit IDs, status, numeric counts/bytes, and exact path/SHA/byte refs. No source strings or source-content objects.
preparation_controls.sizing: Machine-internal exact existing complete header plus each prepared page; report aggregate UTF8 bytes and maximum response characters only. Do not invoke the emitter while sizing.

prerequisites: Canonical new-epoch manifest and required current packets exist.
ROOT accepts exact preparation refs and aggregate actual sizes.
ROOT separately admits the fresh phase, resource ledger and exclusive forward-delivery procedure.

preservation: Preserve all old policies, preparations, observations, closures, failed/stopped attempts and charges. Original adverse issue/packet/review chains remain authoritative and immutable; old 194 resolution for 0041 does not qualify V6. Native0099 is outside this prefix dispatch. No broader gate, whole-source, tokenization, model or human claim is made.
